rules.title: Cambridge policy order to ban algorithmic rent-pricing services (not yet law)
rules.requirement: The City Council passed a policy order starting the process to ban residential property managers from using companies' algorithmic or AI-driven models to recommend rents. It is not yet law; the city manager is to draft policy options or ordinance language for the Council later this term.
rules.requirement_es: El Concejo Municipal aprobó una orden de política para iniciar el proceso de prohibir que los administradores de propiedades residenciales usen modelos algorítmicos o de inteligencia artificial para recomendar los alquileres. Todavía no es ley; el administrador municipal debe redactar opciones de política o texto de ordenanza para el Concejo más adelante en este período.
rules.citation: Cambridge City Council Policy Order (algorithmic rent pricing)
rules.quoted_span: City council also unanimously passed a policy order initiating steps to ban residential property management companies from contracting companies that use algorithmic and AI-driven models to recommend what they should charge for rent.
rules.coverage_conditions: Targets residential property management companies; details not yet drafted.
rules.caveat: Secondary news source; the policy order only directs staff to draft policy options or ordinance language, so no ban is in force and no policy order number is given.
